annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json
Token Delivery: json | Verification: both | MFA: REQUIRED (grace: 0d)
POST /auth/signup (or /mobile) with email and optional phone. Expect challenge if verification required, tokens if not.

specs.title: 2. Complete Email Verification (if required)

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json
Token Delivery: json | Verification: both | MFA: REQUIRED
Test resend code (after 60s delay) → Get email code from /test/email/latest → POST /auth/verify-email/verify → POST /auth/challenges/complete
Skipped if email verification not required

specs.title: 3. Complete Phone Verification (if required)

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json
Token Delivery: json | Verification: both | MFA: REQUIRED (grace: 0d)
Get SMS code from /test/sms/latest → POST /auth/verify-phone/verify → POST /auth/challenges/complete. May trigger MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED if MFA required with no grace period.
Skipped if phone verification not required

specs.title: 3b. Complete MFA Setup (if required)

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json
Token Delivery: json | MFA: REQUIRED (grace: 0d)
Get SMS code from /test/sms/latest → POST /auth/mfa/sms/verify-setup-challenge → POST /auth/challenges/complete. Only runs if MFA required with no grace period.
Skipped if MFA not required or grace period > 0

specs.title: 4. Login

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json
Token Delivery: json | User should be verified from previous steps
POST /auth/login (or /mobile) with email and password. Expect tokens in response (cookies or JSON body).

specs.title: 5. Refresh Token

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json
Token Delivery: json | Uses refresh token from previous login
POST /auth/refresh (or /mobile) with refresh token. Expect new access token in response.

specs.title: 6. Change IP and Login Again (for adaptive MFA testing)

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json
Token Delivery: json | MFA: REQUIRED | Simulates location change
Set IP to 203.0.113.1 → POST /auth/login. With adaptive MFA, may trigger challenge if risk detected.
Skipped if adaptive MFA not enabled

specs.title: 7. Logout

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json
Token Delivery: json | Validates token/cookie invalidation
GET /auth/logout with access token. Expect tokens/cookies cleared (expired or maxAge=0).

specs.title: 2. Complete Email Verification (at signup)

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json - Deferred Both Verification (3b: Skip Phone)

specs.title: 3. Skip Phone Verification (do not complete VERIFY_PHONE challenge)

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json - Deferred Both Verification (3b: Skip Phone)

specs.title: 4. Login (triggers phone verification challenge)

annotations.description: Config: email-phone-mfa-required-json - Deferred Both Verification (3b: Skip Phone)
